item.title: Toronto Zoo giraffe Kiko died from cardiac failure after getting stuck
item.description: The cause of death of Kiko, a 13-year-old male giraffe that died at the Toronto Zoo on New Year’s Day, has now been released. The zoo has received the final post-mortem report on Kiko from the Ontario Veterinary College, University of Guelph, which says the giraffe died from cardiac failure associated with acute muscle exertion.
